question: Did the learned V1 residual preserve primitives whose source evidence was already completely specified by the full reference mask?

interpretation.confirmed_invariant_violation: RegisteredEvidenceToUnaryV1 does not preserve fully observed source evidence. It changes 207285 fully observed primitives and flips 2047 analytic background primitives to foreground at the fixed 0.5 threshold.
interpretation.additional_failure_mode: On the 84334 source-unobserved primitives, V1 flips 2808 analytic foreground primitives to background, so the learned residual can simultaneously corrupt exact evidence and suppress semantic completion.
interpretation.not_proven: This source-only diagnostic does not allocate the target IoU regression to individual primitive strata and is not a post-hoc alternative Room candidate score.

next_general_method.name: observation_clamped_registered_residual_v2
next_general_method.required_invariant: For labeled_coverage equal to one, output probability must equal the exact registered analytic unary. Residual capacity is reserved for source-unobserved or genuinely partial rows, with a globally fixed coverage-dependent gate.
next_general_method.validation: Train and validate on nonbenchmark multi-scene source-to-held-out-target pairs for both full-mask and signed-scribble prompts before any new benchmark sentinel.
